responsibility: Provides the AIX 7.2-specific rs6000 subtarget configuration. Like the neighboring AIX version headers, it defines option overrides, assembler and linker specs, built-in preprocessor macros, multilib/default CPU choices, code-model handling, ABI-relevant typedefs, and debugging defaults, but with AIX 7.2 defaults and feature assumptions such as the selected target ISA masks and assembler baseline.
